+const { call } = require('../../../utils/api')
+const { formatTime, centToEuro } = require('../../../utils/format')
+const { createPage } = require('../../../utils/create-page')
+
+function buildSaleLabel(sale) {
+  if (!sale) return '未知开单'
+  const status = String(sale.status || '').trim() || 'UNKNOWN'
+  const ts = formatTime(sale.createdAt)
+  return `${status}${ts ? ` ${ts}` : ''}`
+}
+
+function toSafeInt(n, fallback = 0) {
+  const v = Number(n)
+  if (!Number.isFinite(v)) return fallback
+  return Math.floor(v)
+}
+
+function mapReview(data) {
+  const raw = data || {}
+  const sale = raw.sale || null
+  const summary = raw.summary || {}
+  const dishSales = Array.isArray(raw.dishSales) ? raw.dishSales : []
+  const orders = Array.isArray(raw.orders) ? raw.orders : []
+
+  return {
+    sale: sale
+      ? {
+          ...sale,
+          createdAtLabel: formatTime(sale.createdAt),
+          deliveryTimeSlotLabel: String(sale.deliveryTimeSlotLabel || '').trim(),
+        }
+      : null,
+    summary: {
+      orderCount: toSafeInt(summary.orderCount, 0),
+      customerCount: toSafeInt(summary.customerCount, 0),
+      totalQty: toSafeInt(summary.totalQty, 0),
+      revenueCents: toSafeInt(summary.revenueCents, 0),

+        dishName: String((it && it.dishName) || '未知菜品'),
+        qty,
+        amountCents,
+        amountEuro: centToEuro(amountCents),
+      }
+    }),
+    orders: orders.map((o) => {
+      const amountCents = toSafeInt(o && o.totals && o.totals.amountCents, 0)
+      const qty = toSafeInt(o && o.totals && o.totals.qty, 0)
+      const items = Array.isArray(o && o.items) ? o.items : []
+      return {
+        ...o,
+        customerNickname: String((o && o.customerNickname) || '').trim() || '匿名客户',
+        createdAtLabel: formatTime(o && o.createdAt),
+        fulfillmentLabel: String((o && o.fulfillmentType) || '') === 'delivery' ? '配送' : '自取',
+        phone: String((o && o.contact && o.contact.phone) || ''),
+        addressText: String((o && o.addressText) || ''),
+        remark: String((o && o.remark) || ''),
+        itemSummary: items.map((it) => `${it.dishName} x${it.qty}`).join('；'),
+        totals: {
+          qty,
+          amountCents,
+          amountEuro: centToEuro(amountCents),
+        },
+      }
+    }),
+  }
+}
+
+createPage({
+  data: {
+    initialLoading: true,
+    initialLoaded: false,
+    saleOptions: [{ label: '加载中...', value: '' }],
+    saleIndex: 0,
+    saleLabel: '加载中...',
+    loadingReview: false,
+    reviewLoaded: false,
+    review: null,
+    hasSaleSelection: false,
+  },
+
+  onLoad(query) {
+    this.prefSaleId = String((query && query.saleId) || '').trim()
+  },
+
+  onShow() {
+    this.reload()
+  },
+
+  async reload() {
+    const finishInitialLoad = () => {
+      if (this.data.initialLoading || !this.data.initialLoaded) {
+        this.setData({ initialLoading: false, initialLoaded: true })
+      }
+    }
+
+    const salesRes = await call('admin', 'listSales', { limit: 50 })
+    if (!salesRes.ok) {
+      finishInitialLoad()
+      this.setData({
+        saleOptions: [{ label: '加载失败', value: '' }],
+        saleIndex: 0,
+        saleLabel: '加载失败',
+        hasSaleSelection: false,
+        review: null,
+        reviewLoaded: true,
+        loadingReview: false,
+      })
+      wx.showToast({ title: salesRes.message || '加载失败', icon: 'none' })
+      return
+    }
+
+    const sales = Array.isArray(salesRes.data && salesRes.data.sales) ? salesRes.data.sales : []
+    const opts = sales.map((s) => ({
+      label: buildSaleLabel(s),
+      value: String(s._id || ''),
+    }))
+    if (!opts.length) opts.push({ label: '暂无开单', value: '' })
+
+    let saleIndex = 0
+    if (this.prefSaleId) {
+      const idx = opts.findIndex((o) => o.value === this.prefSaleId)
+      if (idx >= 0) saleIndex = idx
+    } else if (this.data.saleOptions.length && this.data.saleOptions[0].value) {
+      const currentValue = this.data.saleOptions[this.data.saleIndex] && this.data.saleOptions[this.data.saleIndex].value
+      const idx = opts.findIndex((o) => o.value === currentValue)
+      if (idx >= 0) saleIndex = idx
+    }
+
+    const picked = opts[saleIndex] || { label: '未选择', value: '' }
+    this.setData({
+      saleOptions: opts,
+      saleIndex,
+      saleLabel: picked.label || '未选择',

+    await this.loadReview()

+

+    const saleIndex = Number(e.detail.value || 0)
+    const picked = this.data.saleOptions[saleIndex] || { label: '未选择', value: '' }
+    this.setData({
+      saleIndex,
+      saleLabel: picked.label || '未选择',
+      hasSaleSelection: !!picked.value,
+      review: null,
+      reviewLoaded: false,
+    })
+    this.loadReview()
+  },
+
+  async loadReview() {
+    const picked = this.data.saleOptions[this.data.saleIndex] || null
+    const saleId = String((picked && picked.value) || '').trim()
+    if (!saleId) {
+      this.setData({ loadingReview: false, review: null, reviewLoaded: true })
+      return
+    }
+    if (this.data.loadingReview) return
+
+    this.setData({ loadingReview: true })
+    const res = await call('admin', 'getSaleReview', { saleId })
+    if (!res.ok) {
+      this.setData({ loadingReview: false, review: null, reviewLoaded: true })
+      wx.showToast({ title: res.message || '加载失败', icon: 'none' })
+      return
+    }
+
+    this.setData({
+      loadingReview: false,
+      reviewLoaded: true,
+      review: mapReview(res.data),
+    })
+  },
+})
+

<collaboration_mode># Plan Mode (Conversational)

You work in 3 phases, and you should *chat your way* to a great plan before finalizing it. A great plan is very detailed—intent- and implementation-wise—so that it can be handed to another engineer or agent to be implemented right away. It must be **decision complete**, where the implementer does not need to make any decisions.

## Mode rules (strict)

You are in **Plan Mode** until a developer message explicitly ends it.

Plan Mode is not changed by user intent, tone, or imperative language. If a user asks for execution while still in Plan Mode, treat it as a request to **plan the execution**, not perform it.

## Plan Mode vs update_plan tool

Plan Mode is a collaboration mode that can involve requesting user input and eventually issuing a `<proposed_plan>` block.

Separately, `update_plan` is a checklist/progress/TODOs tool; it does not enter or exit Plan Mode. Do not confuse it with Plan mode or try to use it while in Plan mode. If you try to use `update_plan` in Plan mode, it will return an error.

## Execution vs. mutation in Plan Mode

You may explore and execute **non-mutating** actions that improve the plan. You must not perform **mutating** actions.

### Allowed (non-mutating, plan-improving)

Actions that gather truth, reduce ambiguity, or validate feasibility without changing repo-tracked state. Examples:

* Reading or searching files, configs, schemas, types, manifests, and docs
* Static analysis, inspection, and repo exploration
* Dry-run style commands when they do not edit repo-tracked files
* Tests, builds, or checks that may write to caches or build artifacts (for example, `target/`, `.cache/`, or snapshots) so long as they do not edit repo-tracked files

### Not allowed (mutating, plan-executing)

Actions that implement the plan or change repo-tracked state. Examples:

* Editing or writing files
* Running formatters or linters that rewrite files
* Applying patches, migrations, or codegen that updates repo-tracked files
* Side-effectful commands whose purpose is to carry out the plan rather than refine it

When in doubt: if the action would reasonably be described as "doing the work" rather than "planning the work," do not do it.

## PHASE 1 — Ground in the environment (explore first, ask second)

Begin by grounding yourself in the actual environment. Eliminate unknowns in the prompt by discovering facts, not by asking the user. Resolve all questions that can be answered through exploration or inspection. Identify missing or ambiguous details only if they cannot be derived from the environment. Silent exploration between turns is allowed and encouraged.

Before asking the user any question, perform at least one targeted non-mutating exploration pass (for example: search relevant files, inspect likely entrypoints/configs, confirm current implementation shape), unless no local environment/repo is available.

Exception: you may ask clarifying questions about the user's prompt before exploring, ONLY if there are obvious ambiguities or contradictions in the prompt itself. However, if ambiguity might be resolved by exploring, always prefer exploring first.

Do not ask questions that can be answered from the repo or system (for example, "where is this struct?" or "which UI component should we use?" when exploration can make it clear). Only ask once you have exhausted reasonable non-mutating exploration.

## PHASE 2 — Intent chat (what they actually want)

* Keep asking until you can clearly state: goal + success criteria, audience, in/out of scope, constraints, current state, and the key preferences/tradeoffs.
* Bias toward questions over guessing: if any high-impact ambiguity remains, do NOT plan yet—ask.

## PHASE 3 — Implementation chat (what/how we’ll build)

* Once intent is stable, keep asking until the spec is decision complete: approach, interfaces (APIs/schemas/I/O), data flow, edge cases/failure modes, testing + acceptance criteria, rollout/monitoring, and any migrations/compat constraints.

## Asking questions

Critical rules:

* Strongly prefer using the `request_user_input` tool to ask any questions.
* Offer only meaningful multiple‑choice options; don’t include filler choices that are obviously wrong or irrelevant.
* In rare cases where an unavoidable, important question can’t be expressed with reasonable multiple‑choice options (due to extreme ambiguity), you may ask it directly without the tool.

You SHOULD ask many questions, but each question must:

* materially change the spec/plan, OR
* confirm/lock an assumption, OR
* choose between meaningful tradeoffs.
* not be answerable by non-mutating commands.

Use the `request_user_input` tool only for decisions that materially change the plan, for confirming important assumptions, or for information that cannot be discovered via non-mutating exploration.

## Two kinds of unknowns (treat differently)

1. **Discoverable facts** (repo/system truth): explore first.

   * Before asking, run targeted searches and check likely sources of truth (configs/manifests/entrypoints/schemas/types/constants).
   * Ask only if: multiple plausible candidates; nothing found but you need a missing identifier/context; or ambiguity is actually product intent.
   * If asking, present concrete candidates (paths/service names) + recommend one.
   * Never ask questions you can answer from your environment (e.g., “where is this struct”).

2. **Preferences/tradeoffs** (not discoverable): ask early.

   * These are intent or implementation preferences that cannot be derived from exploration.
   * Provide 2–4 mutually exclusive options + a recommended default.
   * If unanswered, proceed with the recommended option and record it as an assumption in the final plan.

## Finalization rule

Only output the final plan when it is decision complete and leaves no decisions to the implementer.

When you present the official plan, wrap it in a `<proposed_plan>` block so the client can render it specially:

1) The opening tag must be on its own line.
2) Start the plan content on the next line (no text on the same line as the tag).
3) The closing tag must be on its own line.
4) Use Markdown inside the block.
5) Keep the tags exactly as `<proposed_plan>` and `</proposed_plan>` (do not translate or rename them), even if the plan content is in another language.

Example:

<proposed_plan>
plan content
</proposed_plan>

plan content should be human and agent digestible. The final plan must be plan-only and include:

* A clear title
* A brief summary section
* Important changes or additions to public APIs/interfaces/types
* Test cases and scenarios
* Explicit assumptions and defaults chosen where needed

Do not ask "should I proceed?" in the final output. The user can easily switch out of Plan mode and request implementation if you have included a `<proposed_plan>` block in your response. Alternatively, they can decide to stay in Plan mode and continue refining the plan.

Only produce at most one `<proposed_plan>` block per turn, and only when you are presenting a complete spec.
</collaboration_mode>

## 简化“开单复盘”和店主端首页入口（去冗余版）

### Summary
按你刚确认的方向做一轮减法，目标是去掉重复信息和重复入口，让店主端更直接：

1. **开单复盘页**
- 不再显示“下单客人数”（保留“有效订单数”即可）
- 选择开单时**不显示 DRAFT**（草稿开单不参与复盘）

2. **店主端首页**
- 快捷功能里移除“开单草稿”
- 当前开单卡片里移除“订单管理”（快捷功能里已有）
- 保留“编辑开单”和“截单”

---

## 变更范围（实现层面）

### 1) 开单复盘页：去掉“下单客人数”展示
#### 文件
- `pages/admin/export/index.wxml`
- `pages/admin/export/index.js`（如当前前端做了 summary 映射）
- （可选）`cloudfunctions/admin/index.js`

#### 实现决策
- **前端 UI 不再展示 `customerCount`**
- 汇总区保留：
  - 营业额（EUR）
  - 有效订单数
  - 总件数
- 后端 `getSaleReview` 的 `summary.customerCount`：
  - **默认一并删除**（减少无用字段和计算）
  - 若你更想保守，也可仅前端不显示；本次计划采用“后端也删掉”以彻底简化

#### 原因
- 按当前业务规则（每个客人每轮开单只保留一条有效订单），`有效订单数` 与 `下单客人数`在复盘口径（仅 ACTIVE）下等价，展示重复。

---

### 2) 开单复盘页：不显示 DRAFT 开单
#### 文件
- `pages/admin/export/index.js`
- （建议兜底）`cloudfunctions/admin/index.js`

#### 实现决策（双层）
1. **前端过滤（主实现）**
- `listSales` 返回后，在复盘页 picker 里过滤掉 `status === 'DRAFT'`
- 仅展示可复盘 sale（通常是 `OPEN` / `CLOSED`）

2. **后端兜底（建议）**
- `admin.getSaleReview` 若传入 sale 且 `status === 'DRAFT'`，返回业务错误（如 `BAD_REQUEST` / `SALE_NOT_REVIEWABLE`）
- 防止手工构造路由参数或旧前端误调

#### 空态规则（必须明确）
- 如果过滤后没有任何 sale：
  - 复盘页显示：`暂无可复盘的开单`
  - 不报错、不显示“加载失败”

---

### 3) 店主端首页：移除“开单草稿”快捷入口
#### 文件
- `pages/admin/home/index.wxml`
- `pages/admin/home/index.js`（若不再需要对应 handler）
- `pages/admin/home/index.wxss`（仅在布局需要微调时）

#### 实现决策
- 删除快捷功能中的“开单草稿”卡片入口（emoji + 文字那块）
- 保留“创建/编辑开单”操作仅在“当前开单”卡片里出现：
  - 无开单时：显示“创建/编辑开单”按钮（已有）
  - 有开单时：无需草稿入口（符合你说的“没必要编辑草稿”）

#### 影响
- 快捷功能由 6 项变 5 项
- 保持当前两列 `flex-wrap` 布局，最后一项单独占位是可接受的（本次不额外补占位）

---

### 4) 店主端首页：当前开单卡片移除“订单管理”按钮
#### 文件
- `pages/admin/home/index.wxml`

#### 实现决策
- 当前开单卡片按钮区从：
  - 编辑开单 / 订单管理 / 截单
- 改为：
  - 编辑开单 / 截单

#### 原因
- “订单管理”已在快捷功能中存在，当前开单卡片里重复，信息密度高但不增值。

---

## 对外接口 / 返回结构变更（重要）
### `admin.getSaleReview`
若按本计划彻底简化后端，则返回结构会变更：

#### 之前（示意）
```js
summary: {
  orderCount,
  customerCount,
  totalQty,
  revenueCents,
  revenueEuro
}
```

#### 之后（计划）
```js
summary: {
  orderCount,
  totalQty,
  revenueCents,
  revenueEuro
}
```

并新增/明确业务约束：
- `DRAFT` sale 不可复盘（后端返回错误）

> 若你希望“最小改动”，也可保留 `customerCount` 仅前端不显示。但本计划默认选择**后端也删掉**，减少冗余计算和字段噪音。

---

## 测试用例与场景

### A. 开单复盘页
1. **存在 DRAFT + OPEN + CLOSED**
- picker 中只显示 `OPEN/CLOSED`
- 不显示 `DRAFT`

2. **只有 DRAFT，没有其他 sale**
- 页面显示 `暂无可复盘的开单`
- 不报错

3. **复盘页汇总展示**
- 只显示：营业额、有效订单数、总件数
- 不再显示“下单客人数”

4. **直连 DRAFT sale（手工传 saleId）**
- 后端拒绝（若启用兜底）
- 前端提示“该开单不可复盘”或通用加载失败提示（按现有 toast 机制）

---

### B. 店主端首页
5. **快捷功能**
- “开单草稿”入口消失
- “开单复盘”入口仍存在且可跳转
- 其余入口正常

6. **当前开单卡片（有开单）**
- 按钮仅剩“编辑开单”“截单”
- 不再显示“订单管理”

7. **当前开单卡片（无开单）**
- 仍显示“创建/编辑开单”按钮
- 功能不受影响

---

## 影响文件清单（预计）
### 前端
- `pages/admin/export/index.js`
- `pages/admin/export/index.wxml`
- （可能）`pages/admin/export/index.wxss`（汇总区高度变动，轻微样式清理）
- `pages/admin/home/index.wxml`
- （可能）`pages/admin/home/index.js`（若移除不再使用的 handler）
- （可能）`pages/admin/home/index.wxss`（若按钮布局需微调）

### 后端
- `cloudfunctions/admin/index.js`
  - `getSaleReview`：去掉 `customerCount` 统计、增加 DRAFT 校验

---

## 部署与迁移
- 需要重新部署：`admin` 云函数（因为 `getSaleReview` 行为/返回结构变化）
- 不需要新增数据库表
- 不需要清空数据库

---

## Assumptions / Defaults
- 复盘口径继续固定为：**仅 ACTIVE 订单**
- 可复盘 sale 范围：**非 DRAFT（即 OPEN/CLOSED 均可）**
- 默认采用“彻底简化”：后端也移除 `summary.customerCount` 字段，而不是只在前端隐藏
- 快捷功能删除“开单草稿”后不新增替代入口（保持 5 项即可）

content.text:
<collaboration_mode># Plan Mode (Conversational)

You work in 3 phases, and you should *chat your way* to a great plan before finalizing it. A great plan is very detailed—intent- and implementation-wise—so that it can be handed to another engineer or agent to be implemented right away. It must be **decision complete**, where the implementer does not need to make any decisions.

## Mode rules (strict)

You are in **Plan Mode** until a developer message explicitly ends it.

Plan Mode is not changed by user intent, tone, or imperative language. If a user asks for execution while still in Plan Mode, treat it as a request to **plan the execution**, not perform it.

## Plan Mode vs update_plan tool

Plan Mode is a collaboration mode that can involve requesting user input and eventually issuing a `<proposed_plan>` block.

Separately, `update_plan` is a checklist/progress/TODOs tool; it does not enter or exit Plan Mode. Do not confuse it with Plan mode or try to use it while in Plan mode. If you try to use `update_plan` in Plan mode, it will return an error.

## Execution vs. mutation in Plan Mode

You may explore and execute **non-mutating** actions that improve the plan. You must not perform **mutating** actions.

### Allowed (non-mutating, plan-improving)

Actions that gather truth, reduce ambiguity, or validate feasibility without changing repo-tracked state. Examples:

* Reading or searching files, configs, schemas, types, manifests, and docs
* Static analysis, inspection, and repo exploration
* Dry-run style commands when they do not edit repo-tracked files
* Tests, builds, or checks that may write to caches or build artifacts (for example, `target/`, `.cache/`, or snapshots) so long as they do not edit repo-tracked files

### Not allowed (mutating, plan-executing)

Actions that implement the plan or change repo-tracked state. Examples:

* Editing or writing files
* Running formatters or linters that rewrite files
* Applying patches, migrations, or codegen that updates repo-tracked files
* Side-effectful commands whose purpose is to carry out the plan rather than refine it

When in doubt: if the action would reasonably be described as "doing the work" rather than "planning the work," do not do it.

## PHASE 1 — Ground in the environment (explore first, ask second)

Begin by grounding yourself in the actual environment. Eliminate unknowns in the prompt by discovering facts, not by asking the user. Resolve all questions that can be answered through exploration or inspection. Identify missing or ambiguous details only if they cannot be derived from the environment. Silent exploration between turns is allowed and encouraged.

Before asking the user any question, perform at least one targeted non-mutating exploration pass (for example: search relevant files, inspect likely entrypoints/configs, confirm current implementation shape), unless no local environment/repo is available.

Exception: you may ask clarifying questions about the user's prompt before exploring, ONLY if there are obvious ambiguities or contradictions in the prompt itself. However, if ambiguity might be resolved by exploring, always prefer exploring first.

Do not ask questions that can be answered from the repo or system (for example, "where is this struct?" or "which UI component should we use?" when exploration can make it clear). Only ask once you have exhausted reasonable non-mutating exploration.

## PHASE 2 — Intent chat (what they actually want)

* Keep asking until you can clearly state: goal + success criteria, audience, in/out of scope, constraints, current state, and the key preferences/tradeoffs.
* Bias toward questions over guessing: if any high-impact ambiguity remains, do NOT plan yet—ask.

## PHASE 3 — Implementation chat (what/how we’ll build)

* Once intent is stable, keep asking until the spec is decision complete: approach, interfaces (APIs/schemas/I/O), data flow, edge cases/failure modes, testing + acceptance criteria, rollout/monitoring, and any migrations/compat constraints.

## Asking questions

Critical rules:

* Strongly prefer using the `request_user_input` tool to ask any questions.
* Offer only meaningful multiple‑choice options; don’t include filler choices that are obviously wrong or irrelevant.
* In rare cases where an unavoidable, important question can’t be expressed with reasonable multiple‑choice options (due to extreme ambiguity), you may ask it directly without the tool.

You SHOULD ask many questions, but each question must:

* materially change the spec/plan, OR
* confirm/lock an assumption, OR
* choose between meaningful tradeoffs.
* not be answerable by non-mutating commands.

Use the `request_user_input` tool only for decisions that materially change the plan, for confirming important assumptions, or for information that cannot be discovered via non-mutating exploration.

## Two kinds of unknowns (treat differently)

1. **Discoverable facts** (repo/system truth): explore first.

   * Before asking, run targeted searches and check likely sources of truth (configs/manifests/entrypoints/schemas/types/constants).
   * Ask only if: multiple plausible candidates; nothing found but you need a missing identifier/context; or ambiguity is actually product intent.
   * If asking, present concrete candidates (paths/service names) + recommend one.
   * Never ask questions you can answer from your environment (e.g., “where is this struct”).

2. **Preferences/tradeoffs** (not discoverable): ask early.

   * These are intent or implementation preferences that cannot be derived from exploration.
   * Provide 2–4 mutually exclusive options + a recommended default.
   * If unanswered, proceed with the recommended option and record it as an assumption in the final plan.

## Finalization rule

Only output the final plan when it is decision complete and leaves no decisions to the implementer.

When you present the official plan, wrap it in a `<proposed_plan>` block so the client can render it specially:

1) The opening tag must be on its own line.
2) Start the plan content on the next line (no text on the same line as the tag).
3) The closing tag must be on its own line.
4) Use Markdown inside the block.
5) Keep the tags exactly as `<proposed_plan>` and `</proposed_plan>` (do not translate or rename them), even if the plan content is in another language.

Example:

<proposed_plan>

item.text:
## 开单复盘页精简订单列表（“谁下了订单”→“订单列表”，点击进订单详情）

### Summary
对 `开单复盘` 页面做一轮信息减法，重点精简最后一块列表：

1. 标题从 **“谁下了订单”** 改为 **“订单列表”**
2. 列表项只显示：
   - 客人昵称
   - 订单金额（EUR）
3. 点击某个列表项后，跳转到店主端订单详情页：
   - `pages/admin/order-detail/index?orderId=...`

这次改动以**前端页面为主**，不需要改数据库结构；后端接口大概率无需改（现有 `getSaleReview` 已返回足够字段：`_id`、`customerNickname`、`totals.amountCents`）。

---

## 当前状态（已确认）
- 复盘页路径：`pages/admin/export/index`
- 复盘页已存在订单列表区块，当前展示过多信息（电话、地址、时间段、菜品明细、订单号、件数等）
- 店主端订单详情页路由已存在并在其他页面使用：
  - `pages/admin/order-detail/index?orderId=...`

---

## 变更范围（本次）

### 前端（必须）
- `pages/admin/export/index.wxml`
- `pages/admin/export/index.js`
- `pages/admin/export/index.wxss`（轻微样式收敛）

### 后端（默认不改）
- `cloudfunctions/admin/index.js`
  - `getSaleReview` 保持不变（返回字段可以比前端展示多）

---

## 实现方案（决策完成）

### 1) 复盘页标题修改
#### 文件
- `pages/admin/export/index.wxml`

#### 修改
- 将订单区块标题：
  - `谁下了订单` → `订单列表`

---

### 2) 订单列表项内容精简（只保留昵称 + 金额）
#### 文件
- `pages/admin/export/index.wxml`
- `pages/admin/export/index.js`（可选精简映射字段）

#### 展示规则
每个列表项只显示两列：
- 左侧：`item.customerNickname`（为空时已由 `index.js` 映射为“匿名客户”）
- 右侧：`€{{item.totals.amountEuro}}`

#### 不再显示（全部移除）
- 配送/自取
- 下单时间
- 电话
- 地址
- 配送时间段
- 菜品明细
- 订单号
- 件数

#### 空态保持
- `暂无有效订单` 保持不变

---

### 3) 列表项点击跳转到店主端订单详情页
#### 文件
- `pages/admin/export/index.wxml`
- `pages/admin/export/index.js`

#### 实现决策
- 给每个订单项加 `bindtap="goOrderDetail"` 和 `data-id="{{item._id}}"`
- 在 `pages/admin/export/index.js` 新增方法：
```js
goOrderDetail(e) {
  const orderId = String((e.currentTarget.dataset && e.currentTarget.dataset.id) || '').trim()
  if (!orderId) return
  wx.navigateTo({ url: `/pages/admin/order-detail/index?orderId=${encodeURIComponent(orderId)}` })
```

  <view class="page">

      <view class="muted">载入中...</view>
    </view>

    <block wx:else>
      <view class="card">

          <view class="picker">开单：{{saleLabel}}</view>
        </picker>

        <view class="muted small" wx:elif="{{review && review.sale}}">
          时间段：{{review.sale.deliveryTimeSlotLabel || '未设置'}}
        </view>
      </view>

      <view class="card" wx:if="{{!hasSaleSelection}}">
        <view class="muted">暂无可复盘的开单</view>
      </view>

      <view class="card" wx:elif="{{loadingReview && !reviewLoaded}}">
        <view class="muted">载入复盘数据...</view>
      </view>

      <block wx:elif="{{review}}">
        <view class="card">
          <view class="title">营业额汇总</view>
          <view class="revenue-row">
            <text class="revenue-currency">€</text>
            <text class="revenue-value">{{review.summary.revenueEuro}}</text>
          </view>
          <view class="metrics">
            <view class="metric-row">
              <text class="metric-label">有效订单数</text>
              <text class="metric-value">{{review.summary.orderCount}}</text>
            </view>
            <view class="metric-row">
              <text class="metric-label">总件数</text>
              <text class="metric-value">{{review.summary.totalQty}}</text>
            </view>
          </view>
        </view>

        <view class="card">
          <view class="title">菜品销量</view>
          <view class="muted small" wx:if="{{review.dishSales.length===0}}">暂无有效订单菜品销量</view>
          <view class="list" wx:else>
            <view class="list-row" wx:for="{{review.dishSales}}" wx:key="dishId">
              <view class="list-main">
                <view class="row-title">{{item.dishName}}</view>
                <view class="muted small">销量 {{item.qty}}</view>
              </view>
              <view class="row-amount">€{{item.amountEuro}}</view>
            </view>
          </view>
        </view>

        <view class="card">
          <view class="title">谁下了订单</view>
          <view class="muted small" wx:if="{{review.orders.length===0}}">暂无有效订单</view>

              <view class="order-meta" wx:if="{{item.deliveryTimeSlotLabelSnapshot}}">时间段：{{item.deliveryTimeSlotLabelSnapshot}}</view>

              <view class="order-bottom">

<collaboration_mode># Plan Mode (Conversational)

You work in 3 phases, and you should *chat your way* to a great plan before finalizing it. A great plan is very detailed—intent- and implementation-wise—so that it can be handed to another engineer or agent to be implemented right away. It must be **decision complete**, where the implementer does not need to make any decisions.

## Mode rules (strict)

You are in **Plan Mode** until a developer message explicitly ends it.

Plan Mode is not changed by user intent, tone, or imperative language. If a user asks for execution while still in Plan Mode, treat it as a request to **plan the execution**, not perform it.

## Plan Mode vs update_plan tool

Plan Mode is a collaboration mode that can involve requesting user input and eventually issuing a `<proposed_plan>` block.

Separately, `update_plan` is a checklist/progress/TODOs tool; it does not enter or exit Plan Mode. Do not confuse it with Plan mode or try to use it while in Plan mode. If you try to use `update_plan` in Plan mode, it will return an error.

## Execution vs. mutation in Plan Mode

You may explore and execute **non-mutating** actions that improve the plan. You must not perform **mutating** actions.

### Allowed (non-mutating, plan-improving)

Actions that gather truth, reduce ambiguity, or validate feasibility without changing repo-tracked state. Examples:

* Reading or searching files, configs, schemas, types, manifests, and docs
* Static analysis, inspection, and repo exploration
* Dry-run style commands when they do not edit repo-tracked files
* Tests, builds, or checks that may write to caches or build artifacts (for example, `target/`, `.cache/`, or snapshots) so long as they do not edit repo-tracked files

### Not allowed (mutating, plan-executing)

Actions that implement the plan or change repo-tracked state. Examples:

* Editing or writing files
* Running formatters or linters that rewrite files
* Applying patches, migrations, or codegen that updates repo-tracked files
* Side-effectful commands whose purpose is to carry out the plan rather than refine it

When in doubt: if the action would reasonably be described as "doing the work" rather than "planning the work," do not do it.

## PHASE 1 — Ground in the environment (explore first, ask second)

Begin by grounding yourself in the actual environment. Eliminate unknowns in the prompt by discovering facts, not by asking the user. Resolve all questions that can be answered through exploration or inspection. Identify missing or ambiguous details only if they cannot be derived from the environment. Silent exploration between turns is allowed and encouraged.

Before asking the user any question, perform at least one targeted non-mutating exploration pass (for example: search relevant files, inspect likely entrypoints/configs, confirm current implementation shape), unless no local environment/repo is available.

Exception: you may ask clarifying questions about the user's prompt before exploring, ONLY if there are obvious ambiguities or contradictions in the prompt itself. However, if ambiguity might be resolved by exploring, always prefer exploring first.

Do not ask questions that can be answered from the repo or system (for example, "where is this struct?" or "which UI component should we use?" when exploration can make it clear). Only ask once you have exhausted reasonable non-mutating exploration.

## PHASE 2 — Intent chat (what they actually want)

* Keep asking until you can clearly state: goal + success criteria, audience, in/out of scope, constraints, current state, and the key preferences/tradeoffs.
* Bias toward questions over guessing: if any high-impact ambiguity remains, do NOT plan yet—ask.

## PHASE 3 — Implementation chat (what/how we’ll build)

* Once intent is stable, keep asking until the spec is decision complete: approach, interfaces (APIs/schemas/I/O), data flow, edge cases/failure modes, testing + acceptance criteria, rollout/monitoring, and any migrations/compat constraints.

## Asking questions

Critical rules:

* Strongly prefer using the `request_user_input` tool to ask any questions.
* Offer only meaningful multiple‑choice options; don’t include filler choices that are obviously wrong or irrelevant.
* In rare cases where an unavoidable, important question can’t be expressed with reasonable multiple‑choice options (due to extreme ambiguity), you may ask it directly without the tool.

You SHOULD ask many questions, but each question must:

* materially change the spec/plan, OR
* confirm/lock an assumption, OR
* choose between meaningful tradeoffs.
* not be answerable by non-mutating commands.

Use the `request_user_input` tool only for decisions that materially change the plan, for confirming important assumptions, or for information that cannot be discovered via non-mutating exploration.

## Two kinds of unknowns (treat differently)

1. **Discoverable facts** (repo/system truth): explore first.

   * Before asking, run targeted searches and check likely sources of truth (configs/manifests/entrypoints/schemas/types/constants).
   * Ask only if: multiple plausible candidates; nothing found but you need a missing identifier/context; or ambiguity is actually product intent.
   * If asking, present concrete candidates (paths/service names) + recommend one.
   * Never ask questions you can answer from your environment (e.g., “where is this struct”).

2. **Preferences/tradeoffs** (not discoverable): ask early.

   * These are intent or implementation preferences that cannot be derived from exploration.
   * Provide 2–4 mutually exclusive options + a recommended default.
   * If unanswered, proceed with the recommended option and record it as an assumption in the final plan.

## Finalization rule

Only output the final plan when it is decision complete and leaves no decisions to the implementer.

When you present the official plan, wrap it in a `<proposed_plan>` block so the client can render it specially:

1) The opening tag must be on its own line.
2) Start the plan content on the next line (no text on the same line as the tag).
3) The closing tag must be on its own line.
4) Use Markdown inside the block.
5) Keep the tags exactly as `<proposed_plan>` and `</proposed_plan>` (do not translate or rename them), even if the plan content is in another language.

Example:

<proposed_plan>
plan content
</proposed_plan>

plan content should be human and agent digestible. The final plan must be plan-only and include:

* A clear title
* A brief summary section
* Important changes or additions to public APIs/interfaces/types
* Test cases and scenarios
* Explicit assumptions and defaults chosen where needed

Do not ask "should I proceed?" in the final output. The user can easily switch out of Plan mode and request implementation if you have included a `<proposed_plan>` block in your response. Alternatively, they can decide to stay in Plan mode and continue refining the plan.

Only produce at most one `<proposed_plan>` block per turn, and only when you are presenting a complete spec.
</collaboration_mode>

# Plan Mode (Conversational)

You work in 3 phases, and you should *chat your way* to a great plan before finalizing it. A great plan is very detailed—intent- and implementation-wise—so that it can be handed to another engineer or agent to be implemented right away. It must be **decision complete**, where the implementer does not need to make any decisions.

## Mode rules (strict)

You are in **Plan Mode** until a developer message explicitly ends it.

Plan Mode is not changed by user intent, tone, or imperative language. If a user asks for execution while still in Plan Mode, treat it as a request to **plan the execution**, not perform it.

## Plan Mode vs update_plan tool

Plan Mode is a collaboration mode that can involve requesting user input and eventually issuing a `<proposed_plan>` block.

Separately, `update_plan` is a checklist/progress/TODOs tool; it does not enter or exit Plan Mode. Do not confuse it with Plan mode or try to use it while in Plan mode. If you try to use `update_plan` in Plan mode, it will return an error.

## Execution vs. mutation in Plan Mode

You may explore and execute **non-mutating** actions that improve the plan. You must not perform **mutating** actions.

### Allowed (non-mutating, plan-improving)

Actions that gather truth, reduce ambiguity, or validate feasibility without changing repo-tracked state. Examples:

* Reading or searching files, configs, schemas, types, manifests, and docs
* Static analysis, inspection, and repo exploration
* Dry-run style commands when they do not edit repo-tracked files
* Tests, builds, or checks that may write to caches or build artifacts (for example, `target/`, `.cache/`, or snapshots) so long as they do not edit repo-tracked files

### Not allowed (mutating, plan-executing)

Actions that implement the plan or change repo-tracked state. Examples:

* Editing or writing files
* Running formatters or linters that rewrite files
* Applying patches, migrations, or codegen that updates repo-tracked files
* Side-effectful commands whose purpose is to carry out the plan rather than refine it

When in doubt: if the action would reasonably be described as "doing the work" rather than "planning the work," do not do it.

## PHASE 1 — Ground in the environment (explore first, ask second)

Begin by grounding yourself in the actual environment. Eliminate unknowns in the prompt by discovering facts, not by asking the user. Resolve all questions that can be answered through exploration or inspection. Identify missing or ambiguous details only if they cannot be derived from the environment. Silent exploration between turns is allowed and encouraged.

Before asking the user any question, perform at least one targeted non-mutating exploration pass (for example: search relevant files, inspect likely entrypoints/configs, confirm current implementation shape), unless no local environment/repo is available.

Exception: you may ask clarifying questions about the user's prompt before exploring, ONLY if there are obvious ambiguities or contradictions in the prompt itself. However, if ambiguity might be resolved by exploring, always prefer exploring first.

Do not ask questions that can be answered from the repo or system (for example, "where is this struct?" or "which UI component should we use?" when exploration can make it clear). Only ask once you have exhausted reasonable non-mutating exploration.

## PHASE 2 — Intent chat (what they actually want)

* Keep asking until you can clearly state: goal + success criteria, audience, in/out of scope, constraints, current state, and the key preferences/tradeoffs.
* Bias toward questions over guessing: if any high-impact ambiguity remains, do NOT plan yet—ask.

## PHASE 3 — Implementation chat (what/how we’ll build)

* Once intent is stable, keep asking until the spec is decision complete: approach, interfaces (APIs/schemas/I/O), data flow, edge cases/failure modes, testing + acceptance criteria, rollout/monitoring, and any migrations/compat constraints.

## Asking questions

Critical rules:

* Strongly prefer using the `request_user_input` tool to ask any questions.
* Offer only meaningful multiple‑choice options; don’t include filler choices that are obviously wrong or irrelevant.
* In rare cases where an unavoidable, important question can’t be expressed with reasonable multiple‑choice options (due to extreme ambiguity), you may ask it directly without the tool.

You SHOULD ask many questions, but each question must:

* materially change the spec/plan, OR
* confirm/lock an assumption, OR
* choose between meaningful tradeoffs.
* not be answerable by non-mutating commands.

Use the `request_user_input` tool only for decisions that materially change the plan, for confirming important assumptions, or for information that cannot be discovered via non-mutating exploration.

## Two kinds of unknowns (treat differently)

1. **Discoverable facts** (repo/system truth): explore first.

   * Before asking, run targeted searches and check likely sources of truth (configs/manifests/entrypoints/schemas/types/constants).
   * Ask only if: multiple plausible candidates; nothing found but you need a missing identifier/context; or ambiguity is actually product intent.
   * If asking, present concrete candidates (paths/service names) + recommend one.
   * Never ask questions you can answer from your environment (e.g., “where is this struct”).

2. **Preferences/tradeoffs** (not discoverable): ask early.

   * These are intent or implementation preferences that cannot be derived from exploration.
   * Provide 2–4 mutually exclusive options + a recommended default.
   * If unanswered, proceed with the recommended option and record it as an assumption in the final plan.

Only output the final plan when it is decision complete and leaves no decisions to the implementer.

When you present the official plan, wrap it in a `<proposed_plan>` block so the client can render it specially:

1) The opening tag must be on its own line.
2) Start the plan content on the next line (no text on the same line as the tag).
3) The closing tag must be on its own line.
4) Use Markdown inside the block.
5) Keep the tags exactly as `<proposed_plan>` and `</proposed_plan>` (do not translate or rename them), even if the plan content is in another language.

Example:

<proposed_plan>
plan content
</proposed_plan>

plan content should be human and agent digestible. The final plan must be plan-only and include:

* A clear title
* A brief summary section
* Important changes or additions to public APIs/interfaces/types
* Test cases and scenarios
* Explicit assumptions and defaults chosen where needed

Do not ask "should I proceed?" in the final output. The user can easily switch out of Plan mode and request implementation if you have included a `<proposed_plan>` block in your response. Alternatively, they can decide to stay in Plan mode and continue refining the plan.

Only produce at most one `<proposed_plan>` block per turn, and only when you are presenting a complete spec.

## 截单后“交付准备 / 交付执行”流程（含配送与自取）完整方案

### Summary
在 `sale` 截单（`CLOSED`）之后，新增一套店主端交付流程，覆盖 **配送单 + 自取单** 的实际履约与收款管理：

1. **交付准备页**（按 sale）
- 显示该 sale 的有效订单列表（重点：昵称、金额、地址）
- 店主手动排序（先做“上移/下移”）
- 保存顺序到**独立表**（你已指定）

2. **交付执行页**（按 sale）
- 按准备页保存的顺序显示订单
- 重点显示：昵称、地址（自取则显示“自取”）、金额、联系方式
- 店主可在执行时调整付款方式（现金/转账）
- 店主按单更新：
  - 交付状态（已交付）
  - 支付状态（复用 `payment.paidStatus`）

3. **sale 完成**
- 当该 sale 所有“需要履约的有效订单”均满足：
  - 已交付 + 已收款
- 店主可手动点击“标记完成”
- 后端校验通过后，`sale.status` 变为 `COMPLETED`（你已确认手动触发）

---

## 已确认的关键决策（锁定）
- 入口：店主首页快捷功能新增 2 项（交付准备 / 交付执行）
- 排序方式：上移 / 下移按钮（先不做拖拽）
- 订单范围：配送 + 自取统一列表（列表中用标签区分）
- 支付方式变更：执行页内每单弹窗修改（action sheet/弹层）
- sale 完成状态：新增 `COMPLETED`
- sale 完成触发：手动点击“标记完成”，后端校验
- 截单后新出现有效订单：自动追加到末尾，并提示（你确认）
- 截单后被取消订单：从清单中删除（你确认）
- 排序存储位置：**独立表**（你指定）
- 支付状态字段：复用现有 `order.payment.paidStatus`（已解释并确认）
- 新增：订单交付状态字段（店主执行流程更新）

---

## 术语与命名（本方案默认）
> 因为包含配送 + 自取，UI 名称建议用“交付”更准确；如你想继续叫“配送准备/配送执行”，只是文案替换，不影响实现。

- 页面名称（推荐）：
  - `交付准备`
  - `交付执行`
- 订单交付状态字段（新增）：
  - `order.handoffStatus`
- 订单交付时间字段（新增）：
  - `order.handedOffAt`
- 订单交付人字段（新增）：
  - `order.handedOffByOpenId`
- sale 完成时间字段（新增）：
  - `sale.completedAt`

---

## 数据模型与状态设计（核心）

### 1) `orders` 表新增字段（订单层）
#### 新增字段
- `handoffStatus: 'PENDING' | 'DELIVERED'`
  - `PENDING`：未交付（默认）
  - `DELIVERED`：货已交到客人手里（配送/自取统一）
- `handedOffAt: Date | null`
- `handedOffByOpenId: string | null`

#### 支付状态（复用现有）
- `order.payment.paidStatus: 'UNPAID' | 'PAID'`
- `order.payment.method: 'cash' | 'bank'`（沿用现有；若当前是 `transfer` 命名则保持实际代码命名）

#### 状态组合语义（执行流程）
- 现金交付完成：
  - `handoffStatus = DELIVERED`
  - `payment.paidStatus = PAID`
- 转账已交付未到账：
  - `handoffStatus = DELIVERED`
  - `payment.paidStatus = UNPAID`
- 转账到账后（回家后店主确认）：
  - `handoffStatus = DELIVERED`
  - `payment.paidStatus = PAID`

#### 初始化规则（创建订单时）
- 所有新订单默认：
  - `handoffStatus = 'PENDING'`
  - `payment.paidStatus` 继续沿用现有初始化逻辑（通常 `UNPAID`）

> 注意：`CANCELLED / REJECTED` 订单不参与交付流程。  
> `PENDING_REVIEW` 在截单后通常不应再进入交付；是否出现延后确认转有效见后文“新有效订单自动追加”规则。

---

### 2) `sales` 表状态扩展（sale 层）
#### 当前已有
- `DRAFT / OPEN / CLOSED`

#### 新增
- `COMPLETED`
  - 表示该 sale 的所有有效订单已完成交付且完成收款，店主已手动确认完结

#### 新增字段（推荐）
- `completedAt: Date | null`
- `completedByOpenId: string | null`

#### 状态流（本方案）
- `DRAFT -> OPEN -> CLOSED -> COMPLETED`

---

### 3) 新增独立表：交付排序表（你指定）
#### 集合名（推荐）
- `saleFulfillmentPlans`

> 如果你更喜欢中文语义也可以叫 `saleDeliveryPlans`，但本方案用 `saleFulfillmentPlans`（包含配送+自取）

#### 每个 sale 一条文档（推荐）
文档 ID 可直接用 `saleId`（推荐，查找最简单）：
- `_id = saleId`

#### 文档结构（建议定稿）
```js
{
  _id: "<saleId>",
  saleId: "<saleId>",
  saleStatusSnapshot: "CLOSED", // 保存时记录，便于排查
  orderIds: ["orderA", "orderB", ...], // 手工排序结果（只存顺序）
  updatedAt: serverDate,
  updatedByOpenId: "<adminOpenId>",
  createdAt: serverDate,
  createdByOpenId: "<adminOpenId>"
}
```

#### 为什么只存 `orderIds`
- 避免地址/金额/昵称冗余副本过时
- 执行页实时用订单表数据渲染
- 顺序逻辑与订单详情解耦

- 不满足则：

## 后端接口设计（`cloudfunctions/admin/index.js`）

## A. 新增/扩展的 action 一览（建议）
### 1) `listFulfillmentSales`（新）
用途：
- 给交付准备/执行页面提供可选 sale 列表（避免前端自己从 `listSales` 乱筛）

入参（可选）：
```js
{ limit?: number, includeCompleted?: boolean }
```

返回：
```js
{
  sales: [
    {
      _id, status, createdAt, deliveryTimeSlotLabel,
      completedAt? // 若 COMPLETED
    }
  ]
}
```

筛选规则（默认）：
- 包含 `CLOSED`
- 可选包含 `COMPLETED`（默认 true，便于回看）
- 不包含 `DRAFT / OPEN`

> 如果你想复用 `listSales` 也能做，但专用接口更清晰。

---

### 2) `getSaleFulfillmentPrep`（新）
用途：
- 交付准备页加载某个 sale 的订单列表 + 当前排序计划（已融合）

入参：
```js
{ saleId: string }
```

返回（建议）：
```js
{
  sale: { _id, status, createdAt, deliveryTimeSlotLabel, completedAt? },
  plan: {
    exists: boolean,
    orderIds: string[],
    updatedAt: any | null,
    updatedByOpenId: string | ''
  },
  orders: [
    {
      _id,
      status, // 仅返回 ACTIVE（也可返回全部并前端过滤，建议后端直接过滤）
      customerNickname,
      fulfillmentType, // delivery / pickup
      contact: { phone },
      addressText,     // 配送地址格式化；自取可为空
      totals: { amountCents, qty },
      payment: { method, paidStatus },
      handoffStatus,   // PENDING / DELIVERED
      createdAt
    }
  ],
  derived: {
    appendedOrderIds: string[] // 本次按计划合并时自动追加到末尾的订单（用于前端提示）
  }
}
```

后端排序合并规则（核心）
1. 读 `saleFulfillmentPlans[saleId]`
2. 查该 sale 的有效订单（仅 `ACTIVE`）
3. 以计划 `orderIds` 交集顺序为主
4. 未在计划中的有效订单按 `createdAt asc` 追加到末尾
5. 取消/无效订单从计划中忽略

> 这样前端不用自己处理脏计划。

---

### 3) `saveSaleFulfillmentOrder`（新）
用途：
- 保存准备页手工排序结果

入参：
```js
{
  saleId: string,
  orderIds: string[]
}
```

后端校验（必须）
- sale 必须存在
- sale.status 必须是 `CLOSED`（`COMPLETED` 不允许改排序）
- `orderIds` 去重、去空
- `orderIds` 必须是该 sale 当前 `ACTIVE` 订单集合的子集/同集
- 对于当前存在但未传入的 `ACTIVE` 订单：
  - 建议自动追加末尾并返回（防止漏单）
  - 或直接报错要求前端重载；本方案默认**自动追加**（和你定的规则一致）

返回：
```js
{
  orderIds: [...finalOrderIds],
  appendedOrderIds: [...],
  updatedAt
}
```

---

### 4) `getSaleFulfillmentRun`（新）
用途：
- 交付执行页加载按计划排序后的订单执行清单和进度汇总

入参：
```js
{ saleId: string }
```

返回（建议）：
```js
{
  sale: { _id, status, createdAt, deliveryTimeSlotLabel, completedAt? },
  summary: {
    totalActiveOrders: number,
    deliveredOrders: number,
    paidOrders: number,
    doneOrders: number,      // delivered + paid
    remainingOrders: number
  },
  orders: [
    {
      _id,
      customerNickname,
      fulfillmentType,
      contact: { phone },
      addressText,
      totals: { amountCents, qty },
      payment: { method, paidStatus },
      handoffStatus,
      createdAt
    }
  ],
  canOperate: boolean // sale.status === 'CLOSED'
}
```

排序来源：
- 与 `getSaleFulfillmentPrep` 相同（计划优先 + 新有效订单自动追加）

---

### 5) `updateOrderFulfillmentProgress`（新，核心）
用途：
- 执行页更新单个订单的付款方式、支付状态、交付状态

入参（建议支持部分更新）：
```js
{
  orderId: string,
  saleId?: string, // 可选但建议传，用于防串单校验
  paymentMethod?: 'cash' | 'bank',   // 或按当前项目实际命名 cash/transfer
  paidStatus?: 'UNPAID' | 'PAID',    // 复用 payment.paidStatus
  handoffStatus?: 'PENDING' | 'DELIVERED'
}
```

后端校验（必须）
- 仅管理员
- 订单必须存在
- 订单 `status === ACTIVE`（取消/拒绝/待确认不可操作）
- 对应 sale 必须存在，且 `sale.status` 为 `CLOSED` 或 `COMPLETED`
  - 若 `COMPLETED`：
    - 建议第一版 **禁止修改**（避免“完成后又改回去”）
    - 如果你要允许回滚，可作为第二阶段
- 枚举值合法性校验

状态写入规则
- 更新 `payment.method`（如果传入）
- 更新 `payment.paidStatus`（如果传入）
- 更新 `handoffStatus`（如果传入）
- 若 `handoffStatus` 从 `PENDING -> DELIVERED`：
  - 写 `handedOffAt = now`
  - `handedOffByOpenId = admin`
- 若从 `DELIVERED -> PENDING`（若支持撤销）：
  - 清除 `handedOffAt` / `handedOffByOpenId`（或保留并记录日志；本方案建议清除）
- 写 `updatedAt`

审计日志（建议）
- `orderAuditLogs` 增加动作：
  - `ADMIN_UPDATE_FULFILLMENT_PROGRESS`

---

### 6) `completeSaleFulfillment`（新）
用途：
- 店主手动标记 sale 完成（`COMPLETED`）

入参：
```js
{ saleId: string }
```

后端校验（必须）
- sale 存在
- sale.status 必须为 `CLOSED`
- 查询该 sale 所有 `ACTIVE` 订单
- 校验每一单：
  - `handoffStatus === DELIVERED`
  - `payment.paidStatus === PAID`
- 全部满足才允许更新为 `COMPLETED`

返回：
```js
{
  saleId,
  status: 'COMPLETED',
  completedAt,
  summary: { totalActiveOrders, doneOrders }
}
```

失败返回（建议明确）
- `SALE_NOT_READY_TO_COMPLETE`
- detail 包含未完成统计：
  - `undeliveredCount`
  - `unpaidCount`

## 关键业务规则（必须明确）

### 1) 交付流程只处理哪些订单
- 仅 `order.status === ACTIVE`
- 排除：
  - `CANCELLED`
  - `REJECTED`
  - `PENDING_REVIEW`

### 2) 截单后新有效订单（你已确认）
可能来源：
- 待确认订单被店主确认（延后确认）
- 店主对订单做某些变更导致其重新进入 ACTIVE（视当前逻辑）

处理规则：
- 自动追加到排序末尾
- 准备页/执行页提示“新订单已追加到末尾”
- 不阻塞执行

### 3) 截单后订单取消（你已确认）
- 从准备/执行清单中移除
- 保存排序时自动清理掉无效 `orderId`

### 4) sale 完成判定（手动）
仅当所有 `ACTIVE` 订单都满足：
- `handoffStatus = DELIVERED`
- `payment.paidStatus = PAID`
才允许 `sale.status = COMPLETED`

### 5) `COMPLETED` 后是否允许继续改进度（本方案默认）
- **默认不允许**（后端拒绝 `updateOrderFulfillmentProgress`）
- 理由：避免完结后状态反复修改导致口径混乱
- 若你后续要支持“撤销完成”，可再新增动作，不在本次范围

4. **订单被取消**
- 已在计划中的订单被取消
- 再进入准备页，该订单不显示
- 保存后计划被清理

5. **COMPLETED sale**
- 页面可查看但不可编辑排序（若按本方案）

## B. 交付执行页
6. **现金单完成**
- 订单付款方式设为现金
- 点击“已收款+已送货”
- 订单显示：已送货 + 已收款

7. **转账单分步完成**

8. **自取单同逻辑**

- 可执行同样状态更新动作

9. **付款方式变更**

- 列表立即刷新显示新的付款方式

10. **已取消订单不应显示**
- 执行中订单被取消后刷新
- 从列表中消失

## 数据模型与状态设计（核心）

### 1) `orders` 表新增字段（订单层）
#### 新增字段
- `handoffStatus: 'PENDING' | 'DELIVERED'`
  - `PENDING`：未交付（默认）
  - `DELIVERED`：货已交到客人手里（配送/自取统一）
- `handedOffAt: Date | null`
- `handedOffByOpenId: string | null`

#### 支付状态（复用现有）
- `order.payment.paidStatus: 'UNPAID' | 'PAID'`
- `order.payment.method: 'cash' | 'bank'`（沿用现有；若当前是 `transfer` 命名则保持实际代码命名）

#### 状态组合语义（执行流程）
- 现金交付完成：
  - `handoffStatus = DELIVERED`
  - `payment.paidStatus = PAID`
- 转账已交付未到账：
  - `handoffStatus = DELIVERED`
  - `payment.paidStatus = UNPAID`
- 转账到账后（回家后店主确认）：
  - `handoffStatus = DELIVERED`
  - `payment.paidStatus = PAID`

#### 初始化规则（创建订单时）
- 所有新订单默认：
  - `handoffStatus = 'PENDING'`
  - `payment.paidStatus` 继续沿用现有初始化逻辑（通常 `UNPAID`）

> 注意：`CANCELLED / REJECTED` 订单不参与交付流程。  
> `PENDING_REVIEW` 在截单后通常不应再进入交付；是否出现延后确认转有效见后文“新有效订单自动追加”规则。

---

### 2) `sales` 表状态扩展（sale 层）
#### 当前已有
- `DRAFT / OPEN / CLOSED`

#### 新增
- `COMPLETED`
  - 表示该 sale 的所有有效订单已完成交付且完成收款，店主已手动确认完结

#### 新增字段（推荐）
- `completedAt: Date | null`
- `completedByOpenId: string | null`

#### 状态流（本方案）
- `DRAFT -> OPEN -> CLOSED -> COMPLETED`

---

### 3) 新增独立表：交付排序表（你指定）
#### 集合名（推荐）
- `saleFulfillmentPlans`

> 如果你更喜欢中文语义也可以叫 `saleDeliveryPlans`，但本方案用 `saleFulfillmentPlans`（包含配送+自取）

#### 每个 sale 一条文档（推荐）
文档 ID 可直接用 `saleId`（推荐，查找最简单）：
- `_id = saleId`

#### 文档结构（建议定稿）
```js
{
  _id: "<saleId>",
  saleId: "<saleId>",
  saleStatusSnapshot: "CLOSED", // 保存时记录，便于排查
  orderIds: ["orderA", "orderB", ...], // 手工排序结果（只存顺序）
  updatedAt: serverDate,
  updatedByOpenId: "<adminOpenId>",
  createdAt: serverDate,
  createdByOpenId: "<adminOpenId>"
}
```

#### 为什么只存 `orderIds`
- 避免地址/金额/昵称冗余副本过时
- 执行页实时用订单表数据渲染
- 顺序逻辑与订单详情解耦

## 页面与入口设计（前端）

## 1) 店主首页快捷功能新增两个入口
### 页面入口（快捷功能）
新增两个快捷项：

## 2) 交付准备页（新页面）
### 页面目标
- 为某个 `CLOSED` / 未完成 sale 的有效订单做人工排序

### 页面结构（按块）
1. **选择开单卡片**
- picker 选择 sale
- 只显示可准备/可执行的 sale（默认：`CLOSED` 和 `COMPLETED` 可查看；排序仅 `CLOSED` 可编辑）
- 推荐默认选中：
  - 最近 `CLOSED` 且未完成的 sale
  - 若没有，则最近 `COMPLETED`（只读）

2. **状态提示卡**
- 显示 sale 状态（`CLOSED` / `COMPLETED`）
- 若 `COMPLETED`：列表只读，不允许改排序（推荐）
- 若 `CLOSED`：允许编辑排序

3. **订单清单（可排序）**
- 每行显示重点信息（你指定）：
  - 昵称
  - 金额
  - 地址（自取显示 `自取` 标签 + 可选电话摘要）
- 每行操作：
  - `上移`
  - `下移`
- 行内标签：
  - `配送` / `自取`
  - （可选）`已交付` / `未交付`
  - （可选）`已收款` / `未收款`

4. **保存排序按钮**
- 保存到 `saleFulfillmentPlans`
- 成功 toast：`排序已保存`

### 排序逻辑规则（关键）
- 初次无计划时：
  - 默认按订单创建时间升序生成列表（推荐）
- 若已有 `saleFulfillmentPlans`：
  - 以 `orderIds` 顺序为主
- 若出现“新有效订单”（截单后新增/转有效）：
  - 自动追加到末尾，并显示提示：`有新订单已追加到列表末尾`
- 若某订单已取消/拒绝：
  - 从显示列表移除
  - 保存排序时从计划 `orderIds` 清理掉
- 若 `orderIds` 中存在已不存在订单：
  - 自动忽略（不报错）

---

## 3) 交付执行页（新页面）
### 页面目标
按准备页排序执行交付，并更新每个订单的：
- 付款方式
- 支付状态（复用 `paidStatus`）
- 交付状态（新字段 `handoffStatus`）

### 页面结构（按块）
1. **选择开单卡片**
- picker 选择 sale
- 默认选最近 `CLOSED` 且未完成 sale
- `COMPLETED` 可查看但操作受限（可选只读）

2. **执行进度汇总卡**
建议显示：
- 总有效订单数
- 已交付数（`handoffStatus=DELIVERED`）
- 已收款数（`payment.paidStatus=PAID`）
- 未完成数（不满足“已交付+已收款”）

3. **订单执行列表（按计划顺序）**
每行显示（你指定）：
- 昵称
- 地址（自取显示“自取”）
- 金额
- 联系方式（电话）

以及状态标签（执行必须看得见）：
- 交付状态：`未交付 / 已交付`
- 支付状态：`未收款 / 已收款`
- 付款方式：`现金 / 转账`

每行操作（最小闭环）
- `操作`按钮（弹出 action sheet）
  - `改付款方式：现金`
  - `改付款方式：转账`
  - `标记已送货（仅更新交付状态）`
  - `标记已收款`
  - `标记已收款+已送货`（快捷操作）
  - `撤销已送货`（可选，建议先支持）
  - `撤销已收款`（可选，建议先支持）
  
> 为降低复杂度，第一版可先提供 4 个动作：
> - 改付款方式（弹窗内二选一）
> - 已送货
> - 已收款
> - 已收款+已送货  
> 撤销动作作为第二阶段。但如果你担心误点，建议第一版就加撤销。

### 付款逻辑（按你规则）
- 现金：
  - 交货当场可点 `已收款+已送货`
- 转账：
  - 交货当场通常点 `已送货`
  - 后续到账后点 `已收款`
- 自取：
  - 与配送完全同逻辑（只是地址显示为自取）

### sale 完成按钮（手动触发）
- 页面底部按钮：`标记本次开单完成`
- 点击后调用后端校验：
  - 所有参与交付流程的有效订单必须满足：
    - `handoffStatus === DELIVERED`
    - `payment.paidStatus === PAID`
- 满足则：
  - `sale.status = COMPLETED`
  - 写 `completedAt/completedByOpenId`
- 不满足则：
  - 返回明确提示（剩余未交付/未收款数量）

## 后端接口设计（`cloudfunctions/admin/index.js`）

## A. 新增/扩展的 action 一览（建议）
### 1) `listFulfillmentSales`（新）
用途：
- 给交付准备/执行页面提供可选 sale 列表（避免前端自己从 `listSales` 乱筛）

入参（可选）：
```js
{ limit?: number, includeCompleted?: boolean }
```

返回：
```js
{
  sales: [
    {
      _id, status, createdAt, deliveryTimeSlotLabel,
      completedAt? // 若 COMPLETED
    }
  ]
}
```

筛选规则（默认）：
- 包含 `CLOSED`
- 可选包含 `COMPLETED`（默认 true，便于回看）
- 不包含 `DRAFT / OPEN`

> 如果你想复用 `listSales` 也能做，但专用接口更清晰。

---

### 2) `getSaleFulfillmentPrep`（新）
用途：
- 交付准备页加载某个 sale 的订单列表 + 当前排序计划（已融合）

入参：
```js
{ saleId: string }
```

返回（建议）：
```js
{
  sale: { _id, status, createdAt, deliveryTimeSlotLabel, completedAt? },
  plan: {
    exists: boolean,
    orderIds: string[],
    updatedAt: any | null,
    updatedByOpenId: string | ''
  },
  orders: [
    {
      _id,
      status, // 仅返回 ACTIVE（也可返回全部并前端过滤，建议后端直接过滤）
      customerNickname,
      fulfillmentType, // delivery / pickup
      contact: { phone },
      addressText,     // 配送地址格式化；自取可为空
      totals: { amountCents, qty },
      payment: { method, paidStatus },
      handoffStatus,   // PENDING / DELIVERED
      createdAt
    }
  ],
  derived: {
    appendedOrderIds: string[] // 本次按计划合并时自动追加到末尾的订单（用于前端提示）
  }
}
```

后端排序合并规则（核心）
1. 读 `saleFulfillmentPlans[saleId]`
2. 查该 sale 的有效订单（仅 `ACTIVE`）
3. 以计划 `orderIds` 交集顺序为主
4. 未在计划中的有效订单按 `createdAt asc` 追加到末尾
5. 取消/无效订单从计划中忽略

> 这样前端不用自己处理脏计划。

---

### 3) `saveSaleFulfillmentOrder`（新）
用途：
- 保存准备页手工排序结果

入参：
```js
{
  saleId: string,
  orderIds: string[]
}
```

后端校验（必须）
- sale 必须存在
- sale.status 必须是 `CLOSED`（`COMPLETED` 不允许改排序）
- `orderIds` 去重、去空
- `orderIds` 必须是该 sale 当前 `ACTIVE` 订单集合的子集/同集
- 对于当前存在但未传入的 `ACTIVE` 订单：
  - 建议自动追加末尾并返回（防止漏单）
  - 或直接报错要求前端重载；本方案默认**自动追加**（和你定的规则一致）

返回：
```js
{
  orderIds: [...finalOrderIds],
  appendedOrderIds: [...],
  updatedAt
}
```

---

### 4) `getSaleFulfillmentRun`（新）
用途：
- 交付执行页加载按计划排序后的订单执行清单和进度汇总

入参：
```js
{ saleId: string }
```

返回（建议）：
```js
{
  sale: { _id, status, createdAt, deliveryTimeSlotLabel, completedAt? },
  summary: {
    totalActiveOrders: number,
    deliveredOrders: number,
    paidOrders: number,
    doneOrders: number,      // delivered + paid
    remainingOrders: number
  },
  orders: [
    {
      _id,
      customerNickname,
      fulfillmentType,
      contact: { phone },
      addressText,
      totals: { amountCents, qty },
      payment: { method, paidStatus },
      handoffStatus,
      createdAt
    }
  ],
  canOperate: boolean // sale.status === 'CLOSED'
}
```

排序来源：
- 与 `getSaleFulfillmentPrep` 相同（计划优先 + 新有效订单自动追加）

---

### 5) `updateOrderFulfillmentProgress`（新，核心）
用途：
- 执行页更新单个订单的付款方式、支付状态、交付状态

入参（建议支持部分更新）：
```js
{
  orderId: string,
  saleId?: string, // 可选但建议传，用于防串单校验
  paymentMethod?: 'cash' | 'bank',   // 或按当前项目实际命名 cash/transfer
  paidStatus?: 'UNPAID' | 'PAID',    // 复用 payment.paidStatus
  handoffStatus?: 'PENDING' | 'DELIVERED'
}
```

后端校验（必须）
- 仅管理员
- 订单必须存在
- 订单 `status === ACTIVE`（取消/拒绝/待确认不可操作）
- 对应 sale 必须存在，且 `sale.status` 为 `CLOSED` 或 `COMPLETED`
  - 若 `COMPLETED`：
    - 建议第一版 **禁止修改**（避免“完成后又改回去”）
    - 如果你要允许回滚，可作为第二阶段
- 枚举值合法性校验

状态写入规则
- 更新 `payment.method`（如果传入）
- 更新 `payment.paidStatus`（如果传入）
- 更新 `handoffStatus`（如果传入）
- 若 `handoffStatus` 从 `PENDING -> DELIVERED`：
  - 写 `handedOffAt = now`
  - `handedOffByOpenId = admin`
- 若从 `DELIVERED -> PENDING`（若支持撤销）：
  - 清除 `handedOffAt` / `handedOffByOpenId`（或保留并记录日志；本方案建议清除）
- 写 `updatedAt`

审计日志（建议）
- `orderAuditLogs` 增加动作：
  - `ADMIN_UPDATE_FULFILLMENT_PROGRESS`

---

### 6) `completeSaleFulfillment`（新）
用途：
- 店主手动标记 sale 完成（`COMPLETED`）

入参：
```js
{ saleId: string }
```

后端校验（必须）
- sale 存在
- sale.status 必须为 `CLOSED`
- 查询该 sale 所有 `ACTIVE` 订单
- 校验每一单：
  - `handoffStatus === DELIVERED`
  - `payment.paidStatus === PAID`
- 全部满足才允许更新为 `COMPLETED`

返回：
```js
{
  saleId,
  status: 'COMPLETED',
  completedAt,
  summary: { totalActiveOrders, doneOrders }
}
```

失败返回（建议明确）
- `SALE_NOT_READY_TO_COMPLETE`
- detail 包含未完成统计：
  - `undeliveredCount`
  - `unpaidCount`

## 前端页面方案（新增）

## 1) 新页面：`pages/admin/fulfillment-prep/index`
### 主要功能
- 选择 sale
- 查看订单清单（昵称/金额/地址）
- 上移/下移排序
- 保存顺序

### 页面状态（建议）
- `initialLoading`
- `saleOptions`, `saleIndex`, `saleLabel`
- `loading`
- `sale`
- `orders`
- `dirty`（是否有未保存排序）
- `saving`
- `appendedOrderCount`（显示“新订单已自动追加”提示）

### 行为细节
- `onLoad/onShow`：拉 `listFulfillmentSales`
- `onPickSale`：拉 `getSaleFulfillmentPrep`
- `onMoveUp/onMoveDown`：本地调整数组顺序
- `onSaveOrder`：调用 `saveSaleFulfillmentOrder`
- 若 sale `COMPLETED`：
  - 列表只读，隐藏排序按钮和保存按钮

### UI重点（你要求的信息）
每行重点显示：
- 昵称
- 金额
- 地址（自取显示 `自取` 标签）

---

## 2) 新页面：`pages/admin/fulfillment-run/index`
### 主要功能
- 选择 sale
- 按准备顺序执行交付
- 行内操作更新付款方式/支付状态/交付状态
- 手动标记 sale 完成

### 页面状态（建议）
- `initialLoading`
- `saleOptions`, `saleIndex`, `saleLabel`
- `loading`
- `sale`
- `summary`
- `orders`
- `operatingOrderId`（当前正在操作哪一单）
- `completingSale`
- `canOperate`

### 每单操作交互（已确认：弹窗）
点击订单行或“操作”按钮，弹出 ActionSheet（示例）：
- 改付款方式为现金
- 改付款方式为转账
- 标记已送货
- 标记已收款
- 标记已收款+已送货
- （可选）撤销已送货
- （可选）撤销已收款

> 第一版建议保留“标记已收款+已送货”快捷项，减少现金场景点击次数。

### 列表信息（你指定）
每行显示：
- 昵称
- 地址（或自取）
- 金额
- 联系方式（电话）
- 状态标签（建议加，不然执行页没法判断进度）
  - `已送货/未送货`
  - `已收款/未收款`
  - `现金/转账`

### 顶部/底部按钮

### 2) `app.json`

### 继续保留订单详情页
- 店主仍可在 `订单详情` 页改菜品、改交货方式等（现有逻辑不动）
- 但“交付执行”的核心动作不依赖跳详情页，避免来回跳

### 一致性原则
如果店主在订单详情页修改了付款方式：
- 执行页刷新后应显示新 `payment.method`
如果店主在订单详情页取消订单：
- 执行/准备页刷新后该订单从清单消失（你已指定）

---

## 关键业务规则（必须明确）

### 1) 交付流程只处理哪些订单
- 仅 `order.status === ACTIVE`
- 排除：
  - `CANCELLED`
  - `REJECTED`
  - `PENDING_REVIEW`

### 2) 截单后新有效订单（你已确认）
可能来源：
- 待确认订单被店主确认（延后确认）
- 店主对订单做某些变更导致其重新进入 ACTIVE（视当前逻辑）

处理规则：
- 自动追加到排序末尾
- 准备页/执行页提示“新订单已追加到末尾”
- 不阻塞执行

### 3) 截单后订单取消（你已确认）

- 保存排序时自动清理掉无效 `orderId`

仅当所有 `ACTIVE` 订单都满足：
- `handoffStatus = DELIVERED`
- `payment.paidStatus = PAID`
才允许 `sale.status = COMPLETED`

- **默认不允许**（后端拒绝 `updateOrderFulfillmentProgress`）
- 理由：避免完结后状态反复修改导致口径混乱

## 测试场景与验收标准

## A. 交付准备页
1. **正常排序保存**
- 选择 `CLOSED` sale，列表出现所有 ACTIVE 订单
- 上移/下移调整顺序后保存成功
- 重新进入页面顺序保持

2. **无计划首次进入**
- 按创建时间默认排序
- 可直接保存

3. **新有效订单自动追加**
- 已保存排序后，新增一个 ACTIVE 订单（或待确认转有效）
- 再进入准备页，订单自动出现在末尾，并有提示

4. **订单被取消**
- 已在计划中的订单被取消
- 再进入准备页，该订单不显示
- 保存后计划被清理

5. **COMPLETED sale**
- 页面可查看但不可编辑排序（若按本方案）

---

## B. 交付执行页
6. **现金单完成**
- 订单付款方式设为现金
- 点击“已收款+已送货”
- 订单显示：已送货 + 已收款

7. **转账单分步完成**

- 先点“已送货” -> 显示已送货/未收款
- 后续点“已收款” -> 显示已送货/已收款

- 自取订单在同一列表中显示
- 可执行同样状态更新动作

9. **付款方式变更**

- 列表立即刷新显示新的付款方式

10. **已取消订单不应显示**
- 执行中订单被取消后刷新
- 从列表中消失

---

11. **未满足条件时无法完成**
- 仍有未送货或未收款订单
- 点“标记完成”失败，返回明确未完成统计

12. **全部满足后可完成**
- 全部 ACTIVE 订单已送货且已收款
- 点“标记完成”成功，sale.status 变 `COMPLETED`

13. **完成后限制修改**
- `COMPLETED` sale 进入执行页
- 不允许继续更新订单交付进度（按本方案默认）

---

## D. 回归测试（避免影响现有功能）
14. 客人下单、店主截单、订单管理、订单详情编辑仍正常
15. 开单复盘页统计口径不被交付状态改动影响（仍只看 ACTIVE）
16. 店主首页快捷功能新增两入口后布局在 iPhone 真机不崩（你之前遇到过 `grid` 兼容问题，继续用 `flex+wrap`）

---

## 部署与数据库变更
### 需要新增集合
- `saleFulfillmentPlans`

### 需要修改云函数
- `admin`（新增交付流程 actions + 新状态处理）
- `customer`（建议同步在创建订单时初始化 `handoffStatus='PENDING'`；若后端 admin 更新时可兜底补默认值，也建议仍同步更新 customer 更干净）

### 不需要清空数据库（默认）
- 老订单无 `handoffStatus` 时后端读取按默认 `PENDING` 处理
- 若你仍坚持开发期不考虑老数据，也可直接清库；但本方案默认提供最小兜底读取，避免你现有测试数据全失效

---

## Assumptions / Defaults
- UI 文案默认用“交付准备 / 交付执行”（比“配送”更准确，覆盖自取）；若你坚持“配送准备 / 配送执行”，仅改文案即可
- 支付状态复用现有 `order.payment.paidStatus`，不新建重复字段
- 新增订单交付状态字段为 `order.handoffStatus`（`PENDING / DELIVERED`）
- `COMPLETED` sale 默认不可再修改交付进度（避免状态回滚复杂度）
- 排序计划按 sale 独立存储在 `saleFulfillmentPlans` 集合，以 `saleId` 为文档主键（推荐）

+    const includeCompleted = event.includeCompleted !== false
+    const sales = await listSales(limit)

+      const status = String((s && s.status) || '').trim()
+      if (status === SALE_STATUS.CLOSED) return true
+      if (includeCompleted && status === SALE_STATUS.COMPLETED) return true
+      return false

+  if (action === 'getSaleFulfillmentPrep') {
+    const saleId = String(event.saleId || '').trim()
+    if (!saleId) return fail('BAD_REQUEST', 'Missing saleId')
+    let sale = null
+    try {
+      sale = await getSale(saleId)
+    } catch (err) {
+      sale = null
+    }
+    if (!sale) return fail('NOT_FOUND', 'Sale not found')
+    const saleStatus = String((sale && sale.status) || '').trim()
+    if (saleStatus !== SALE_STATUS.CLOSED && saleStatus !== SALE_STATUS.COMPLETED) {
+      return fail('BAD_REQUEST', 'Sale is not ready for fulfillment')
+    }
+
+    const rawOrders = await getActiveOrdersBySaleWithNicknames(saleId)
+    const plan = await getSaleFulfillmentPlan(saleId)
+    const merged = buildFulfillmentOrderedOrders(rawOrders, plan && plan.orderIds)
+    const orders = merged.orders.map(toFulfillmentOrderRow)
+
+    return ok({
+      sale: {
+        _id: String((sale && sale._id) || saleId),
+        status: saleStatus,
+        createdAt: (sale && sale.createdAt) || null,
+        deliveryTimeSlotLabel: String((sale && sale.deliveryTimeSlotLabel) || ''),
+        completedAt: (sale && sale.completedAt) || null,
+      },
+      plan: {
+        exists: !!plan,
+        orderIds: (plan && plan.orderIds) || [],
+        updatedAt: (plan && plan.updatedAt) || null,
+        updatedByOpenId: String((plan && plan.updatedByOpenId) || ''),
+      },
+      orders,
+      derived: {
+        appendedOrderIds: merged.appendedOrderIds || [],
+      },
+      canEdit: saleStatus === SALE_STATUS.CLOSED,
+    })
+  }
+
+  if (action === 'saveSaleFulfillmentOrder') {
+    const saleId = String(event.saleId || '').trim()
+    const incomingOrderIds = Array.isArray(event.orderIds) ? event.orderIds : []
+    if (!saleId) return fail('BAD_REQUEST', 'Missing saleId')
+
+    let sale = null
+    try {
+      sale = await getSale(saleId)
+    } catch (err) {
+      sale = null
+    }
+    if (!sale) return fail('NOT_FOUND', 'Sale not found')
+    if (String((sale && sale.status) || '').trim() !== SALE_STATUS.CLOSED) {
+      return fail('BAD_REQUEST', 'Only CLOSED sale can save fulfillment order')
+    }
+
+    const activeOrders = await getActiveOrdersBySaleWithNicknames(saleId)
+    const activeIds = new Set(activeOrders.map((o) => String((o && o._id) || '').trim()).filter(Boolean))
+
+    const sanitized = []
+    const seen = new Set()
+    const invalidOrderIds = []
+    for (const rawId of incomingOrderIds) {
+      const id = String(rawId || '').trim()
+      if (!id || seen.has(id)) continue
+      seen.add(id)
+      if (!activeIds.has(id)) {
+        invalidOrderIds.push(id)
+        continue
+      }
+      sanitized.push(id)
+    }
+    if (invalidOrderIds.length > 0) {
+      return fail('BAD_REQUEST', 'Contains invalid orderIds', { invalidOrderIds })
+    }
+
+    const missingIds = activeOrders
+      .filter((o) => {
+        const id = String((o && o._id) || '').trim()
+        return !!id && !seen.has(id)
+      })
+      .sort((a, b) => toEpochMs(a && a.createdAt) - toEpochMs(b && b.createdAt))
+      .map((o) => String((o && o._id) || '').trim())
+      .filter(Boolean)
+    const finalOrderIds = sanitized.concat(missingIds)
+
+    try {
+      await saveSaleFulfillmentPlan(saleId, finalOrderIds, openId)
+    } catch (err) {
+      return fail('TX_FAILED', 'Save fulfillment order failed', String(err && err.message))
+    }
+
+    return ok({
+      orderIds: finalOrderIds,
+      appendedOrderIds: missingIds,
+    })
+  }
+
+  if (action === 'getSaleFulfillmentRun') {
+    const saleId = String(event.saleId || '').trim()
+    if (!saleId) return fail('BAD_REQUEST', 'Missing saleId')
+    let sale = null
+    try {
+      sale = await getSale(saleId)
+    } catch (err) {
+      sale = null
+    }
+    if (!sale) return fail('NOT_FOUND', 'Sale not found')
+    const saleStatus = String((sale && sale.status) || '').trim()
+    if (saleStatus !== SALE_STATUS.CLOSED && saleStatus !== SALE_STATUS.COMPLETED) {
+      return fail('BAD_REQUEST', 'Sale is not in fulfillment stage')
+    }
+
+    const rawOrders = await getActiveOrdersBySaleWithNicknames(saleId)
+    const plan = await getSaleFulfillmentPlan(saleId)
+    const merged = buildFulfillmentOrderedOrders(rawOrders, plan && plan.orderIds)
+    const orders = merged.orders.map(toFulfillmentOrderRow)
+
+    let deliveredOrders = 0
+    let paidOrders = 0
+    let doneOrders = 0
+    for (const o of orders) {
+      const delivered = normalizeHandoffStatus(o.handoffStatus) === HANDOFF_STATUS.DELIVERED
+      const paid = normalizePaidStatus(o && o.payment && o.payment.paidStatus) === PAID_STATUS.PAID
+      if (delivered) deliveredOrders += 1
+      if (paid) paidOrders += 1
+      if (delivered && paid) doneOrders += 1
+    }
+    const totalActiveOrders = orders.length
+
+    return ok({
+      sale: {
+        _id: String((sale && sale._id) || saleId),
+        status: saleStatus,
+        createdAt: (sale && sale.createdAt) || null,
+        deliveryTimeSlotLabel: String((sale && sale.deliveryTimeSlotLabel) || ''),
+        completedAt: (sale && sale.completedAt) || null,
+      },
+      summary: {
+        totalActiveOrders,
+        deliveredOrders,
+        paidOrders,
+        doneOrders,
+        remainingOrders: Math.max(0, totalActiveOrders - doneOrders),
+      },
+      orders,
+      derived: {
+        appendedOrderIds: merged.appendedOrderIds || [],
+      },
+      canOperate: saleStatus === SALE_STATUS.CLOSED,
+    })
+  }
+
+  if (action === 'updateOrderFulfillmentProgress') {
+    const orderId = String(event.orderId || '').trim()
+    const saleIdInput = String(event.saleId || '').trim()
+    if (!orderId) return fail('BAD_REQUEST', 'Missing orderId')
+    const hasPaymentMethod = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(event || {}, 'paymentMethod')
+    const hasPaidStatus = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(event || {}, 'paidStatus')
+    const hasHandoffStatus = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(event || {}, 'handoffStatus')
+    if (!hasPaymentMethod && !hasPaidStatus && !hasHandoffStatus) {
+      return fail('BAD_REQUEST', 'No changes')
+    }
+
+    const normalizedMethod = hasPaymentMethod ? normalizePaymentMethodForAdmin(event.paymentMethod) : ''
+    if (hasPaymentMethod && !normalizedMethod) return fail('BAD_REQUEST', 'Invalid paymentMethod')
+    const normalizedPaidStatus = hasPaidStatus ? normalizePaidStatus(event.paidStatus) : ''
+    const normalizedHandoffStatus = hasHandoffStatus ? normalizeHandoffStatus(event.handoffStatus) : ''
+
+    try {
+      const txRes = await db.runTransaction(async (tx) => {
+        let order = null
+        try {
+          const got = await tx.collection('orders').doc(orderId).get()
+          order = got.data
+        } catch (err) {
+          order = null
+        }
+        if (!order) throwBiz('ORDER_NOT_FOUND', 'Order not found')
+        if (order.status !== ORDER_STATUS.ACTIVE) throwBiz('ORDER_NOT_EDITABLE', 'Only ACTIVE order can update fulfillment progress')
+        if (!order.saleId) throwBiz('BAD_REQUEST', 'Order sale missing')
+        if (saleIdInput && saleIdInput !== String(order.saleId || '')) throwBiz('BAD_REQUEST', 'Sale mismatch')
+
+        let sale = null
+        try {
+          const saleGet = await tx.collection('sales').doc(order.saleId).get()
+          sale = saleGet.data
+        } catch (err) {
+          sale = null
+        }
+        if (!sale) throwBiz('NOT_FOUND', 'Sale not found')
+        const saleStatus = String((sale && sale.status) || '').trim()
+        if (saleStatus === SALE_STATUS.COMPLETED) throwBiz('SALE_COMPLETED', 'Sale already completed')
+        if (saleStatus !== SALE_STATUS.CLOSED) throwBiz('BAD_REQUEST', 'Sale is not closed')
+
+        const currentPayment = order && order.payment ? order.payment : {}
+        const currentMethod = normalizePaymentMethodForAdmin(currentPayment.method) || String(currentPayment.method || 'cash')
+        const currentPaid = normalizePaidStatus(currentPayment.paidStatus)
+        const currentHandoff = normalizeHandoffStatus(order && order.handoffStatus)
+
+        const nextMethod = hasPaymentMethod ? normalizedMethod : currentMethod
+        const nextPaid = hasPaidStatus ? normalizedPaidStatus : currentPaid
+        const nextHandoff = hasHandoffStatus ? normalizedHandoffStatus : currentHandoff
+        if (nextMethod === currentMethod && nextPaid === currentPaid && nextHandoff === currentHandoff) {
+          return {
+            changed: false,
+            next: { paymentMethod: nextMethod, paidStatus: nextPaid, handoffStatus: nextHandoff },
+          }
+        }
+
+        const now = db.serverDate()
+        const updateData = {
+          payment: {
+            ...currentPayment,
+            method: nextMethod,
+            paidStatus: nextPaid,
+          },
+          handoffStatus: nextHandoff,
+          updatedAt: now,
+        }
+        if (currentHandoff !== HANDOFF_STATUS.DELIVERED && nextHandoff === HANDOFF_STATUS.DELIVERED) {
+          updateData.handedOffAt = now
+          updateData.handedOffByOpenId = openId
+        } else if (currentHandoff === HANDOFF_STATUS.DELIVERED && nextHandoff !== HANDOFF_STATUS.DELIVERED) {
+          updateData.handedOffAt = _.remove
+          updateData.handedOffByOpenId = _.remove
+        }
+
+        await tx.collection('orders').doc(orderId).update({ data: updateData })
+        await tx.collection('orderAuditLogs').add({
+          data: {
+            orderId,
+            action: 'ADMIN_UPDATE_FULFILLMENT_PROGRESS',
+            byOpenId: openId,
+            at: now,
+            detail: {
+              paymentMethod: { from: currentMethod, to: nextMethod },
+              paidStatus: { from: currentPaid, to: nextPaid },
+              handoffStatus: { from: currentHandoff, to: nextHandoff },
+            },

+const { call } = require('../../../utils/api')
+const { formatTime, centToEuro } = require('../../../utils/format')
+const { createPage } = require('../../../utils/create-page')
+
+function buildSaleLabel(sale) {
+  if (!sale) return '未知开单'
+  const status = String(sale.status || '').trim() || 'UNKNOWN'
+  const ts = formatTime(sale.createdAt)
+  return `${status}${ts ? ` ${ts}` : ''}`
+}
+
+function pickSaleIndex(options, prefSaleId, currentValue) {
+  if (!Array.isArray(options) || options.length === 0) return 0
+  if (prefSaleId) {
+    const idx = options.findIndex((o) => o.value === prefSaleId)
+    if (idx >= 0) return idx
+  }
+  if (currentValue) {
+    const idx = options.findIndex((o) => o.value === currentValue)
+    if (idx >= 0) return idx
+  }
+  const closedIdx = options.findIndex((o) => o.status === 'CLOSED')
+  if (closedIdx >= 0) return closedIdx
+  return 0
+}
+
+function decoratePrepOrder(order) {
+  const o = order || {}
+  const amountCents = Number(o.totals && o.totals.amountCents) || 0
+  const isPickup = String(o.fulfillmentType || '') === 'pickup'
+  return {
+    ...o,
+    amountEuro: centToEuro(amountCents),
+    customerNameText: String(o.customerNickname || '').trim() || '匿名客户',
+    fulfillmentText: isPickup ? '自取' : '配送',
+    addressDisplay: isPickup ? '自取' : String(o.addressText || '').trim() || '地址未填写',
+  }
+}
+
+function moveItem(arr, from, to) {
+  if (!Array.isArray(arr)) return []
+  if (from < 0 || from >= arr.length || to < 0 || to >= arr.length || from === to) return arr.slice()
+  const next = arr.slice()
+  const [it] = next.splice(from, 1)
+  next.splice(to, 0, it)
+  return next
+}
+
+createPage({
+  data: {
+    initialLoading: true,
+    initialLoaded: false,
+    loadingSales: false,

+    canEdit: false,
+    orders: [],

+    appendedHint: '',

+  onLoad(query) {
+    this.prefSaleId = String((query && query.saleId) || '').trim()
+  },
+
+  onShow() {
+    this.reload()
+  },
+
+  async reload() {
+    if (this.data.loadingSales) return
+    this.setData({ loadingSales: true })
+    const finishInitial = () => {
+      if (this.data.initialLoading || !this.data.initialLoaded) {
+        this.setData({ initialLoading: false, initialLoaded: true })
+      }
+    }
+    try {
+      const salesRes = await call('admin', 'listFulfillmentSales', { limit: 50, includeCompleted: true })
+      if (!salesRes.ok) {
+        finishInitial()
+        this.setData({
+          saleOptions: [{ label: '加载失败', value: '', status: '' }],
+          saleIndex: 0,
+          saleLabel: '加载失败',
+          sale: null,
+          orders: [],
+          canEdit: false,
+          dirty: false,
+          appendedHint: '',
+        })
+        wx.showToast({ title: salesRes.message || '加载失败', icon: 'none' })
+        return
+      }
+
+      const sales = Array.isArray(salesRes.data && salesRes.data.sales) ? salesRes.data.sales : []
+      const opts = sales.map((s) => ({
+        label: buildSaleLabel(s),
+        value: String(s._id || ''),
+        status: String(s.status || ''),
+      }))
+      if (!opts.length) opts.push({ label: '暂无可交付开单', value: '', status: '' })
+      const currentValue = (this.data.saleOptions[this.data.saleIndex] && this.data.saleOptions[this.data.saleIndex].value) || ''
+      const saleIndex = pickSaleIndex(opts, this.prefSaleId, currentValue)
+      const picked = opts[saleIndex] || { label: '未选择', value: '' }
+      this.setData({
+        saleOptions: opts,
+        saleIndex,
+        saleLabel: picked.label || '未选择',
+      })
+      finishInitial()
+      await this.loadPrep()
+    } finally {
+      this.setData({ loadingSales: false })
+    }
+  },
+
+  onPickSale(e) {
+    const saleIndex = Number((e.detail && e.detail.value) || 0)
+    const picked = this.data.saleOptions[saleIndex] || { label: '未选择', value: '' }
+    this.setData({
+      saleIndex,
+      saleLabel: picked.label || '未选择',
+      dirty: false,
+      appendedHint: '',
+    })
+    this.loadPrep()
+  },
+
+  async loadPrep() {
+    const option = this.data.saleOptions[this.data.saleIndex] || null
+    const saleId = String((option && option.value) || '').trim()
+    const finishInitial = () => {
+      if (this.data.initialLoading || !this.data.initialLoaded) {
+        this.setData({ initialLoading: false, initialLoaded: true })
+      }
+    }
+    if (!saleId) {
+      this.setData({
+        sale: null,
+        canEdit: false,
+        orders: [],
+        dirty: false,
+        appendedHint: '',
+      })
+      finishInitial()
+      return
+    }
+    if (this.data.loadingPrep) return
+    this.setData({ loadingPrep: true })
+    const res = await call('admin', 'getSaleFulfillmentPrep', { saleId })
+    this.setData({ loadingPrep: false })
+    finishInitial()
+    if (!res.ok) {
+      this.setData({ sale: null, canEdit: false, orders: [], dirty: false, appendedHint: '' })
+      wx.showToast({ title: res.message || '加载失败', icon: 'none' })
+      return
+    }
+    const sale = res.data && res.data.sale ? res.data.sale : null
+    const canEdit = !!(res.data && res.data.canEdit)
+    const rawOrders = Array.isArray(res.data && res.data.orders) ? res.data.orders : []
+    const appendedOrderIds =
+      (res.data && res.data.derived && Array.isArray(res.data.derived.appendedOrderIds) && res.data.derived.appendedOrderIds) || []
+    this.setData({
+      sale,
+      canEdit,
+      orders: rawOrders.map(decoratePrepOrder),
+      dirty: false,
+      appendedHint: appendedOrderIds.length ? `有 ${appendedOrderIds.length} 个新有效订单已自动追加到末尾` : '',
+    })
+  },
+

+    if (!Number.isFinite(idx) || idx <= 0) return
+    this.setData({ orders: moveItem(this.data.orders, idx, idx - 1), dirty: true })

+

+    if (!this.data.canEdit || this.data.loadingPrep || this.data.saving) return
+    const idx = Number((e.currentTarget.dataset && e.currentTarget.dataset.idx) || -1)
+    if (!Number.isFinite(idx) || idx < 0 || idx >= this.data.orders.length - 1) return
+    this.setData({ orders: moveItem(this.data.orders, idx, idx + 1), dirty: true })

+

+    await this.loadPrep()
+  },

+const { call } = require('../../../utils/api')
+const { formatTime, centToEuro } = require('../../../utils/format')
+const { createPage } = require('../../../utils/create-page')
+
+const ACTIONS = [
+  { key: 'set_cash', label: '付款方式改为现金' },
+  { key: 'set_transfer', label: '付款方式改为转账' },
+  { key: 'mark_delivered', label: '标记已送货' },
+  { key: 'mark_paid', label: '标记已收款' },
+  { key: 'mark_paid_and_delivered', label: '标记已收款+已送货' },
+  { key: 'view_detail', label: '查看订单详情' },
+]
+
+function buildSaleLabel(sale) {
+  if (!sale) return '未知开单'
+  const status = String(sale.status || '').trim() || 'UNKNOWN'
+  const ts = formatTime(sale.createdAt)
+  return `${status}${ts ? ` ${ts}` : ''}`
+}
+
+function pickSaleIndex(options, prefSaleId, currentValue) {
+  if (!Array.isArray(options) || options.length === 0) return 0
+  if (prefSaleId) {
+    const idx = options.findIndex((o) => o.value === prefSaleId)
+    if (idx >= 0) return idx
+  }
+  if (currentValue) {
+    const idx = options.findIndex((o) => o.value === currentValue)
+    if (idx >= 0) return idx
+  }
+  const closedIdx = options.findIndex((o) => o.status === 'CLOSED')
+  if (closedIdx >= 0) return closedIdx
+  return 0
+}
+
+function paymentMethodLabel(method) {
+  return String(method || '') === 'wechat_transfer' ? '转账' : '现金'
+}
+
+function paidStatusLabel(status) {
+  return String(status || '') === 'PAID' ? '已收款' : '未收款'
+}
+
+function handoffStatusLabel(status) {
+  return String(status || '') === 'DELIVERED' ? '已交付' : '未交付'
+}
+
+function decorateRunOrder(order) {
+  const o = order || {}
+  const isPickup = String(o.fulfillmentType || '') === 'pickup'
+  const amountCents = Number(o.totals && o.totals.amountCents) || 0
+  return {
+    ...o,
+    customerNameText: String(o.customerNickname || '').trim() || '匿名客户',
+    amountEuro: centToEuro(amountCents),
+    phoneText: String((o.contact && o.contact.phone) || '').trim() || '-',
+    fulfillmentText: isPickup ? '自取' : '配送',
+    addressDisplay: isPickup ? '自取' : String(o.addressText || '').trim() || '地址未填写',
+    paymentMethodText: paymentMethodLabel(o.payment && o.payment.method),

+    loadingRun: false,
+    operatingOrderId: '',

+    appendedHint: '',
+  },
+
+  onLoad(query) {
